svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Exhaust grille (room face, drawn): 240 wide x 210 tall, 21 slots

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4 wide x 170 long at 10 centres. Supply grille (lid): 90 x 240,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 slots 4 wide x 200 long at 10 centres.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Or buy perforated aluminium sheet with holes no larger than 5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and cut it to the same sizes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 4.5 hole 6 in from each corner; deburr every edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each grille covers its opening with 10 to spare all round,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: held by four M4 bolts with nuts inside the box.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The grilles keep fingers off the fans: no opening wider than 5.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a pencil cannot pass through any slot.
